# netgear_vlans (Data Source)

Every VLAN the switch has configured, read from the `vlan database` block of `show running-config`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netgear_vlans" "all" {}

output "vlan_ids" {
  value = [for vlan in data.netgear_vlans.all.vlans : vlan.vlan_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Constant `vlans`. The framework requires an id.
- `vlans` (Attributes List) The VLANs, in ascending id order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans))

<a id="nestedatt--vlans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) VLAN name, empty when the switch has none for it.
- `routing` (Boolean) Whether `vlan routing` is enabled for this VLAN.
- `tagged_ports` (Set of String) Ports carrying this VLAN tagged, in FASTPATH notation such as `0/1`.
- `untagged_ports` (Set of String) Ports participating in this VLAN untagged.
- `vlan_id` (Number) The 802.1Q VLAN id.
